name: anteroom
description: Play Anteroom while a long Claude task runs. A running-task HUD and a 'finished' nudge show inside the game (launch 'anteroom'). The hooks record only timestamps, never your prompts or transcripts.

interface.shortDescription: Play a quick game while a long turn runs
interface.longDescription: Two (or more) people play a quick game for play-money chips while a long turn runs. A running-task HUD and a 'finished' nudge appear inside the game, so you never switch back just to check whether it's done. The hooks record only timestamps, never your prompts or transcripts.
